rows.question: Wie kann ich die E-Mail-Adresse in meinem Konto ändern?
rows.reason: The customer wants to change their email address in their account, which is relevant to the Account category.
rows.message: Navigate to Settings > Profile > Contact Information. Enter your new email address and click Save. A verification email will be sent to the new address — you must click the link to confirm the change. Your old email remains active until the new one is verified.
